messages.content: Ensure each word in your response has at least one consonant cluster (two or more consonants together). Does power law scaling in neural networks imply that there must be an exponential increase in the size of training dataset to get modest performance improvements?

message.content: No. Power-law scaling does not necessitate exponential dataset expansion for modest gains. Empirical studies demonstrate predictable, often linear or logarithmic, relationships between data volume and model accuracy. Such findings refute mandatory exponential growth assumptions.
